window.aggregation: raw GPS points clipped to fixed [start, start + 120s) windows

quality_policy.missing_coordinates: exclude point from valid trajectory; do not synthesize coordinates
quality_policy.timestamp_gaps: retain gap_step_count feature and reject windows below runtime duration contract
quality_policy.outliers: no model-side coordinate fabrication; use shared window feature calculator
quality_policy.probability_calibration: none; raw classifier probabilities are exposed and Brier score is reported

augmentation.policy: add at most 3 deterministic train windows per linked user; never add linked rows to AI-Hub validation/test

selection: validation Macro F1 on UID-disjoint AI-Hub split
v3_policy: deprecated historical benchmark; excluded from model selection and release gate
